evidence.title: Cezar repository
evidence.finding: open-mercato/cezar: 1072 stars on 2026-11-16, MIT, latest release v0.20.0 (2026-11-15), homepage cezar.run; separate desktop-v0.1.x releases.

evidence.title: Cezar README
evidence.locator: Features, Screenshots, Quick start, How it works, Automations, Task dispatch
evidence.finding: Open-source orchestrator running Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi and others in parallel locally or on a VPS; per-task git worktrees with queue; Autonomous mode; live view with tokens and cost; variants; skills and YAML workflows; GitHub/Jira/Linear; automations; child task dispatch (four in flight); no database; phone-responsive cockpit.

evidence.title: cezar reference
evidence.locator: Core concepts, Cockpit tour, Multiple projects, Automatic agent fallback, How it runs agents, API, Coding agent backends, Remote access, Configuration, Worktree lifecycle scripts
evidence.finding: Task run states, FIFO queue with maxParallel (default 2), memory-aware runs, worktree retention, review gate, agent backends and tool limits, HTTP API under /api/v1 with no built-in auth, server-install, config keys, worktree lifecycle hooks, environment flags (dispatch, managers, automations, terminal).

evidence.title: Telemetry
evidence.finding: Telemetry is opt-in: nothing is sent until the user answers yes in the cockpit, Settings > Privacy or cezar telemetry enable; CEZ_TELEMETRY=0 and DO_NOT_TRACK block it; event list given.

evidence.title: Jira Cloud and Linear
evidence.locator: Connect, Storage and isolation, Credentials and read permissions
evidence.finding: Per-project Jira Cloud or Linear connection to browse issues and launch tasks; read-only browsing; event automations; credentials encrypted AES-256-GCM with keychain; per-session tracker capability for read/comment/transition on the task's own issue.

evidence.title: Ubuntu VPS install
evidence.finding: server-install sets up nginx with auth_basic and Let's Encrypt HTTPS plus a systemd service and verifies an anonymous request is challenged; external-proxy mode requires the user's own proxy auth.

evidence.title: Code signing policy
evidence.finding: Windows desktop installer is signed via SignPath; macOS builds signed per Apple scheme; Linux packages unsigned.

evidence.title: E2E verification
evidence.finding: Browser and mobile e2e runs can be a verification step that gates a task.

evidence.title: Webhooks receiver guide
evidence.finding: Opt-in (CEZ_WEBHOOKS=1) signed JSON project lifecycle webhooks with native Slack/Discord notifications.

evidence.title: Cezar desktop release assets
evidence.finding: Desktop assets: macOS aarch64 and x86_64 dmg, Linux x86_64 AppImage, deb and pkg.tar.zst, Windows x86_64 setup exe, desktop-latest.json; no ARM Linux/Windows build, no mobile app.

evidence.title: Tauri desktop configuration
evidence.locator: productName Cezar, version 0.1.11, bundle targets ["app"], macOS minimumSystemVersion 12.0, updater endpoint
evidence.finding: Desktop shell is Tauri 2 (src-tauri) bundling the pre-built cockpit UI (frontendDist ../ui); macOS 12+ minimum; updater via GitHub release JSON.

evidence.title: AgentRunner interface source
evidence.finding: Single AgentRunner seam normalising agent CLI output into events; backends implemented as classes for Claude, Codex, Junie, OpenCode, Cursor, pi and further CLIs.

evidence.title: cezar npm package manifest
evidence.finding: Published npm package @open-mercato/cezar 0.20.0 exposing the cezar/cez/cezar-run binaries; Node >=20.

evidence.title: API client package
evidence.finding: Typed client and contract types for the cockpit HTTP API in the monorepo; marked private (not published).

evidence.title: Task dispatch source directory
evidence.finding: Dispatch implementation: parent/child task tree with briefs, orders, notes, reports and per-task inbox files.

evidence.title: Automations coordinator source
evidence.finding: Automations coordinator schedules GitHub/tracker-triggered and calendar automations that launch ordinary tasks.

evidence.title: Managers source
evidence.finding: Manager agents (global long-lived chat agents connected to projects) with a cez-manager CLI and connectors.

evidence.title: Cezar telemetry doc at v0.20.0
evidence.finding: At v0.20.0 telemetry is opt-in: nothing is sent until the user says yes in the bottom-bar question; Settings > Privacy offers the same answer as a switch; CEZ_TELEMETRY=0 or DO_NOT_TRACK=1 also disable it.

before.answer: Code, prompts and transcripts stay on the host and go only to the chosen agent providers; credentials in an encrypted store (AES-256-GCM, keychain) with secret scrubbing of on-disk state; telemetry is opt-in with documented events and DO_NOT_TRACK/CEZ_TELEMETRY=0 blocks; no training use by Cezar.

after.answer: Code, prompts and transcripts stay on the host and go only to the chosen agent providers; credentials in an encrypted store (AES-256-GCM, keychain) with secret scrubbing of on-disk state; telemetry is opt-in with documented events and DO_NOT_TRACK/CEZ_TELEMETRY=0 blocks; no training use by Cezar.
